arguments.content: P1 lifecycle ownership pattern: queued cleanup keyed by a stable parent/workspace ID must verify the current association belongs to the failed setup ID before deleting it. Serialized execution alone does not protect a newer association: begin failed setup A, complete replacement B for the same workspace, then run A's cleanup. Removing by workspace alone makes the valid B connection disappear. Preserve the setup-ID ownership guard; verify both own-association removal and replacement-association survival in regression coverage. This is delayed-work ordering, not a concurrent dictionary race.
